prompt_inputs.content: CRISPR-Cas9 systems have revolutionized genome editing by enabling precise modifications of DNA sequences with unprecedented efficiency. Recent advances in NHEJ and HDR pathways have improved the fidelity of double-strand break (DSB) repair, while off-target effects remain a critical concern in therapeutic applications. The development of high-fidelity Cas9 variants, including eSpCas9 and SpCas9-HF1, has significantly reduced unintended mutations at similar loci. Furthermore, base editing technologies such as ABEs and CBEs circumvent DSB formation entirely, offering superior accuracy for point mutations. Integration of CRISPR with TALENs and zinc-finger nucleases (ZFNs) in multiplex screening approaches has enabled genome-wide association studies (GWAS) to identify novel disease-associated variants. Epigenetic modifications through dCas9-based systems targeting histone deacetylases (HDACs) and DNA methyltransferases (DNMTs) demonstrate therapeutic potential in cancer immunotherapy and neurodegenerative disorders.

solution_criteria: Extracts technical terminology and acronyms as distinct topics (e.g., CRISPR-Cas9, NHEJ, HDR, DSB, eSpCas9, ABEs, CBEs, TALENs, ZFNs, GWAS, HDACs, DNMTs)
Identifies broader conceptual topics beyond acronyms (e.g., genome editing, base editing, epigenetic modifications, off-target effects)
Returns output as a valid JSON array of strings with no duplicates
task_description: Extract topics out of a passage of text from a scholarly article into a JSON array of strings
scenario: Testing with passage heavy in jargon and acronyms from a specialized field like molecular biology - evaluates whether extraction handles technical terminology and acronym-based topics correctly

prompt_inputs.content: This study examines the role of microbiota in intestinal barrier function, with particular emphasis on tight junction proteins and their regulation by microbial metabolites. The intestinal microbiota produces short-chain fatty acids through fermentation of dietary fiber, which strengthen tight junctions by upregulating claudin and occludin expression. Additionally, microbial-derived butyrate enhances tight junction integrity through histone deacetylase inhibition, while propionate and acetate contribute to barrier function through G-protein coupled receptor signaling. We further investigated how dysbiosis disrupts these microbial-mediated mechanisms, leading to increased intestinal permeability and systemic endotoxemia. Our findings demonstrate that restoring microbial diversity and short-chain fatty acid production reverses barrier dysfunction, suggesting that microbiota-targeted interventions represent a promising therapeutic approach for conditions characterized by compromised intestinal barrier function.

solution_criteria: Output is a valid JSON array of strings containing topic names
Avoids duplicate topics despite repeated mentions of 'microbiota', 'tight junctions', and 'short-chain fatty acids'
Maintains appropriate granularity by distinguishing between related but distinct topics (e.g., 'tight junction proteins' vs. 'barrier dysfunction')
Captures all major topics without over-extraction of synonymous concepts
task_description: Extract topics out of a passage of text from a scholarly article into a JSON array of strings
